description: Travel between islands and loot chests in this small PICO-8 adventure game.

0.1.0.description: hopefully the last release, but probably not. i expect to have made a mistake somewhere
0.1.0.title: first release

0.1.0b.description:
added the item jingles. which didn't make it into the initial release

the apworld has not updated since 0.1.0. letters indicate that the client has changed, but not the apworld. if you are using chromanyan.page to play the game and already have the apworld you do not need to do anything
0.1.0b.title: 0.1.0b - item jingles

0.1.0c.description:
keys now display in the upper right corner when you have one and haven't yet used it
adjusted green key texture and yellow gate texture to be easier to differentiate with their counterparts
0.1.0c.title: 0.1.0c - accessibility is key

0.2.0.description:
heart containers and swift feathers are now each a single type of item instead of three
mysterious shapes now have their vanilla effect (which is still doing nothing, but now you can see how many you have)
added temporary hearts to the item pool
you can now play as misty, the mystical fox (cosmetic only)

note: backwards compatibility is not guaranteed. i have confirmed it won't crash and burn immediately, but if you need to play an existing 0.1.0 multiworld i would recommend downloading the 0.1.0c client
0.2.0.title: 0.2.0 - no more jam, no more jank (well at least less of it)
